boundary: Context-bench documents expose legitimate and protected uses in real academic prose. They are not the primary effectiveness test and do not veto a rule. A01 is development-only; stable effectiveness requires held-out AI academic texts from multiple model families, topics, and editing levels.
distribution_note: Document texts are not redistributed. A01 is unpublished third-party material; H01-H03 are open-access articles whose licences permit reuse but which are not this project's to ship. The SHA-256 values let you verify you have the same bytes.
